en.html:
People entered silently into the dimness. Not complete darkness, but enough to close off the room. Several... ten, no, more.

They neither lined up nor formed ranks, apparently choosing their own places. Yet, intentionally or otherwise, they spread around me and the few people nearby.

ja.html:
暗闇ではない、だが薄闇に閉ざされた空間に、複数
の人間が音もなく踏み入ってくる気配があった。
　数人……十人、いやもっと多い。

　彼らは並ぶことも、陣形を取ることもなく、勝手に
思い思いの場所へ身を置いた様子だ。
　しかし、意図してかどうか――俺そして付近の数人
を取り囲むように広がっていた。

en.html:
Wolf"A power behind the continental economy. A leading figure in a new religion. A serial murderer supposedly executed. A film star whose name nobody fails to know."
Wolf"A retired soldier, a clown, a great landowner, a person with multiple personalities, a financial magnate, a physicist, a priest, a high-class courtesan, an expelled Zen monk, a young man who made an immense fortune in stocks and cannot think how to spend it, a genius chef, an astrologer—"
Wolf"No matching at all. Even race and nationality refuse to cooperate."
Wolf"What sort of gathering is this? Have we merely drawn names from all humanity by lottery?"
Kageaki"..."
Wolf"No. Desire brought us together."
Wolf"For one single appetite, we assembled."
Kageaki"What appetite?"
Wolf"God."
Wolf"God, my friend!"
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ａ"God... yes, God."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｂ"If such a thing exists, I should very much like to see it."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｃ"Only God interests me anymore..."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｄ"I require God. Something that can deny my sinful self utterly."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｅ"Loving humans, hating them, raising them, killing them, tormenting them—I am tired of the whole business! Something not human. I want to see God!"
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｆ"Personally, I think it is the perfect joke. ‘God really existed after all!’"
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｇ"Kaa-ha-ha! No such thing as God! If there is, I shall kill it!"
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｈ"Surely God would love me."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｉ"God..."
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｊ"God—"
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｋ"God!"

ウォルフ 「退役軍人、道化師、大地主、多重人格者、 財閥のトップ、物理学者、神父、高級娼婦、 禅宗の破門僧、株で大儲けしたものの使い道 がない青年、天才料理人、占星術師――」
ウォルフ 「バラバラだ。全くバラバラだ。 　人種や国籍さえ統一されていない」
ウォルフ 「一体、これは何の集団だ？ 　全人類からクジか何かで選ばれて集まった だけか？」
景明 「…………」

ウォルフ 「ただ一つの欲求のため、我々は集った」
景明 「それは何だ」
ウォルフ 「神」
ウォルフ 「神だよ！」
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ａ 「神……そう神だ」

ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｃ 「もう神くらいしか興味はない……」
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｄ 「神が必要です。 　罪深き私を完膚なく否定するために」
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｅ 「人間を愛するのも憎むのも育てるのも殺す のも嬲るのも、何もかも飽きた！ 　人ならぬものに会いたい。神を見たい！」

ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｇ 「カァーーカカッ!! 　神なんていねえ！　いたら殺す！」
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｈ 「神様ならきっと、わたしを愛してくれる」

ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｊ 「神を――」
ｅｔｃ／緑龍会Ｋ 「神を！」

en.html:
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"How is it, bhai? Finest collection of useless rubbish, no?"
Chachamaru"Humans no longer satisfy them. Without something called God to cling to, life will not go down."
Chachamaru"And for that, anything is acceptable."
Kageaki"...Anything?"
Chachamaru"One more common point besides the purpose. These fellows can move money and people・・・・・・・・・."
Chachamaru"That power supports us from behind. What you and apun are going to do—"
Chachamaru"Make Silver Starthe Princess a god."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Originally, just an occult society. People bored with living, amusing themselves with magic and alchemy. Now, slightly different..."
Wolf"A few developments occurred."
Wolf"First, I inferred the existence of God. At that time, however, even I lacked confidence in the correctness of my paper."
Wolf"I had to entitle my own work a reverie・・・. Consider the indignity. But then—"
Chachamaru"Apun read Wolf’s paper."
Chachamaru"Apun, who had already sensed God’s existence・・・・・・・・・・・・・."
Kageaki"Sensed...?"
Chachamaru"Apun can hear it. The voice..."
Chachamaru"Was not born human, bhai. So voices humans cannot hear reach apun."
Chachamaru"The fellow screeching away・・・・・・ underground."
Kageaki"..."
